scope_en: Production, prices, finance, public finances and household income and spending.
Jobs, wages, unemployment, vacancies and working conditions.
Dwellings, rents, building, property prices and housing costs.
Health care, causes of death, dental care and health accounts.
Schools, higher education, adult learning, research and innovation.
Libraries, study associations, arts, museums and cultural activity.
Families, children's circumstances and civil society.
Elections, turnout, party sympathy, elected representatives and local democracy.
Sport, outdoor life, holiday homes, tourism and recreational fishing.
Emissions, waste, land use, protected nature and green space.
Religious life, faith communities, meaning and existential practice.
Survey measures of living conditions, life satisfaction and how people say they feel.
Population counts, energy, transport, agriculture, trade, care services and cross-cutting registers.
